shipLog.text: ◆ Station arrival. MARV has compared the posted prices to the ship's balance. The comparison was short. It did not need to be long.
◆ Seeds in medium. MARV notes the crop is the only passenger aboard expected to produce something. He has adjusted his expectations of the others accordingly.
Arrived: The Optimistic Projection. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
The Paperwork. The captain chose “Sign everything without reading”. Noted.
You signed. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Derelict ahead. MARV has read its last log entry. It says 'probably fine.' He has added it to his collection.
Arrived: Route Decision. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Right of Way. The captain chose “Starboard lane — the port beacon has a shifty look”. Noted.
You go starboard. 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ Passing the window: a probe labeled "RETURN TO SENDER".
▶ ASTEROID FIELD AHEAD — GOOD MINING
Arrived: Asteroid Field (beta). The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
◆ CHIP files a reference next to the Provident's registry entry: ships built to carry whole generations are a real, seriously-studied idea.
The Other Colony Ship. The captain chose “Hail them — friendly, mostly”. Noted.
You open a channel and spend an hour trading route notes, complaints… +3 MORALE, 1 DAY. It will not last.
◆ We signed the waivers unread. I read them afterward. I have not shared what we agreed to. It would not help. Nothing does.
Tomato: VEGETATIVE. 26% grown, health 87. Temporarily.
▶ DERELICT DETECTED — PROCEED WITH CAUTION
Arrived: FSS Whatever It Takes. The leg cost +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −2 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Filed.
Uninvited Gardeners. The captain chose “Let the ecosystem argue it out”. Noted.
You leave the bay to its new politics. −2 MORALE, 1 DAY. As calculated.
◆ Something dead ahead. MARV means the derelict. He also means the original crew. He finds the observation worth sitting with.
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.
◆ GROWBAY — pest outbreak treated.
Arrived: Crossroads (The Space Version). The leg cost −3 FOOD, −3 H2O, +2 MORALE, −2 FUEL, −1 O2, 8 DAYS. Filed.
